title: If You Paint a Line on a Road...
sources: TxDOT Pavement Marking Handbook: thermoplastic applied at 400-450 F (420 F recommended); glass beads intermixed and on the surface
SWARCO Thermoplastic Field Guide: beads dropped on the hot stripe right after application, embedded 50-60%; beads give night-time retroreflectivity
US patent 9732480 summary: thermoplastic markings last 3 to 6 years
Snopes / Wikipedia 'Botts' dots' / Caltrans history: Elbert Botts' Caltrans research into raised pavement markers because paint was not visible in the rain
Wikipedia 'Raised pavement marker': raised markers are rarely used where there is heavy snow because plows remove them; snowplowable / recessed markers sit in a groove
Motorcycle Classics, 'Botts' Dots': engineers carve a divot so plows won't disrupt the markers

lines.text: If you paint a white line on a road, you get a lane.
lines.caps: If you paint a white line | on a road, you get a lane.

lines.text: But tires grind regular paint away in a few months.
lines.caps: But tires grind regular paint | away in a few months.

lines.text: So, crews melt plastic to about four hundred degrees,
lines.caps: So, crews melt plastic | to about 400 degrees,

lines.text: and lay it down hot, so it lasts for years.
lines.caps: and lay it down hot, | so it lasts for years.

lines.text: But at night, your headlights hit the line, and it looks gray.
lines.caps: But at night, | your headlights hit the line, | and it looks gray.

lines.text: So, while it's still soft, they sprinkle tiny glass beads on top.
lines.caps: So, while it's still soft, | they sprinkle tiny | glass beads on top.

lines.text: Each bead catches your headlight and sends it straight back to you.
lines.caps: Each bead catches your headlight | and sends it | straight back to you.

lines.text: But in the rain, a thin film of water covers the beads,
lines.caps: But in the rain, | a thin film of water | covers the beads,

lines.text: So, California started gluing raised reflectors between the lanes,
lines.caps: So, California started gluing | raised reflectors | between the lanes,

lines.text: and they stick up above the water.
lines.caps: and they stick up | above the water.

lines.text: But up north, snowplows scrape them right off the road.
lines.caps: But up north, snowplows | scrape them right off the road.

lines.text: So, they cut a little pocket into the road and tuck the reflector inside.
lines.caps: So, they cut a little pocket | into the road | and tuck the reflector inside.

lines.text: You see, every bead is a tiny glass ball that bends light back where it came from.
lines.caps: You see, every bead | is a tiny glass ball | that bends light back | where it came from.

lines.text: That's why road lines glow at night, but look like plain paint all day.
lines.caps: That's why road lines | glow at night, but look | like plain paint all day.
